verification.notes: Body, buttons, ports and MagSafe centre (Apple logo) are Apple's labelled dimensions; a button's pos is its labelled centre minus half its length. The camera plateau spans the full width from the top edge; its lower edge curves down to 34.2 mm at the centre (scaled off the drawing geometry), so the cut-out runs to 34.4 mm. It stands 3.03 mm proud of the back glass, so the case uses an open camera cut-out. The 5.64 mm body limits the USB-C opening to 5.2 mm (Apple recommends 6.6 mm for cable plugs: use a slim plug) and the Camera Control opening to 4.8 mm. Corner radius 12.9 mm is a circular fit to Apple's corner profile. Not fit-tested: print the camera and ports coupons first.
